lines.text: Stop. Quick question. A buyer, a seller and a sapient on the table. Who is the thief?
Whoever put them on the table.
...Good enough. Nuru. You have not met me. The cell has not met you.
The cell. Free Scale is a coalition. I only run a corner of it.

choice.text: I am not here for the Dominion or the Coalition. I am here for the road.
I work for the Coalition. We could share information.

lines.text: The road. Fine. The road is who I work for too.
Everyone is somebody's coalition. I will take your information. I will not take your handshake.
